title: Weak upper-threshold logarithmic ratio
statement:
For a Boolean function $f$ on $
\{−1,1\}^n$ and a real number $p$, let $q_f(p)$ denote its biased-minus probability polynomial. The weak upper-threshold logarithmic ratio is $-\log(1-q_f(p)) - \tfrac12\log p$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the biased-minus probability polynomial, so its precise meaning cannot be specified from this payload alone.
